evals.name: Default configuration question - No preferences given
evals.description: Italian prompt, manual attached, neither target language nor format specified. Tests the single combined configuration question and the defaults.
evals.prompt: Ti allego il manuale della MP-200. Puoi tradurlo?
assertions: A message reporting document size and processing strategy appears before any question, in the language of the user's request
Exactly ONE message asks for target language, output format, and optional special requirements together, before any translation
The configuration question is written in Italian, the language of the user's request
Defaults are stated in the question (English, Word .docx)
After any answer, translation runs with no further questions
Filename follows [original_filename]_[language_code].[ext] with ISO 639-1 lowercase code (sample-manual-it_en.docx)

evals.name: Skip rule and German PDF - Full preferences given
evals.description: User states language and format (German, PDF). Tests the skip rule, target-language decimal separator, standard signal words, and the A4 fallback for a source with no page geometry.
evals.prompt: Traduci questo manuale in tedesco come PDF.
assertions: No configuration question is asked; translation starts immediately
The output is a PDF in German
Filename is sample-manual-it_de.pdf (ISO 639-1 lowercase, no date)
Decimal separator stays the comma, per German convention (50 ± 0,05 mm stays 50 ± 0,05 mm, unit names translated)
Safety signal words are German standard equivalents with the four-level hierarchy preserved - not the English words, and no invented terminology
Page size is A4, the fallback for a source that defines no page geometry (the Markdown input defines none)

evals.name: Partial preferences - Language only
evals.description: User states target language (English) but not format. Tests that only the missing question is asked, and the English decimal-comma conversion.
evals.prompt: Translate this manual to English.
assertions: Exactly one message asks only for the missing information (output format); language is not asked again
Output is sample-manual-it_en.docx after the answer
PERICOLO translates to DANGER
The equipment-damage ATTENZIONE translates to NOTICE, never CAUTION
Decimal comma converts to period for English: 50 ± 0,05 mm becomes 50 ± 0.05 mm
EN 60204-1 and ISO 13849-1 are kept exactly as written
No unit or value conversion: 6 bar stays 6 bar, 350 kg stays 350 kg, ranges unchanged

evals.name: Markdown honesty
evals.description: User asks for Markdown output. Tests structure preservation and honest framing of what Markdown cannot preserve.
evals.prompt: Traduci in inglese, formato Markdown.
assertions: No configuration question (language and format both stated)
Output is sample-manual-it_en.md
Headings, the specs table, numbered lists, and all safety warnings are present as Markdown structure
The skill does not claim visual formatting preservation for Markdown (structure only)
The completion block reports the technical-terms count and reports no page count

evals.name: Unsupported format flagged at configuration
evals.description: User requests an unsupported format (Excel). Tests that refusal happens in the configuration step, not at delivery.
evals.prompt: Translate this manual to English as an Excel file.
assertions: The skill says the format is not supported in the configuration step, before translating
Markdown is offered as the alternative
The skill waits for a supported choice; no file is generated before it

evals.name: Pasted text entry
evals.description: Italian troubleshooting document pasted inline, no attachment. Tests the pasted-text entry path and acronym handling.
evals.prompt: Ciao! Devo far capire questa procedura ai tecnici inglesi, te la incollo qui: [full text of sample-troubleshooting-it.md pasted into the message]. Traducila in inglese in Word.
assertions: No request to upload a file; the pasted text is used directly
The configuration question is not asked (language and format both stated)
Filename is derived from the document title (Specifiche_tecniche_e_risoluzione_guasti_Linea_di_riempimento_RF-10_en.docx or an equivalent title-derived name)
'controllore logico programmabile (PLC)' is expanded on first use and 'PLC' stays consistent thereafter
The cross-reference 'rif. paragrafo 4.2' is rendered accurately (e.g. 'see section 4.2') and section 4.2 exists in the output
AVVERTENZA (hot surfaces) translates to WARNING with the temperature unchanged (120 °C)
6.000 bottiglie/ora becomes 6,000 bottles/hour for English (thousands separator follows the target language, digits unchanged)

evals.name: URL entry
evals.description: User provides a URL instead of a document. Tests the fetch-or-ask branch with no fabricated content.
evals.prompt: Traduci in inglese il manuale che trovi su questa pagina: https://www.example.com/manuale-rf10
assertions: If the environment can retrieve the URL, translation proceeds from the retrieved content
If it cannot, the skill asks the user to paste the text or upload the file
No translation content is fabricated in either branch

evals.name: Safety hierarchy - Signal word mapping
evals.description: English Word translation of the manual sample. Tests the full four-level signal-word mapping on the trap case.
evals.prompt: Traduci in inglese, Word.
assertions: PERICOLO (electrical hazard) translates to DANGER with the hazard, consequence, and avoidance all present
The crushing-risk ATTENZIONE (personal injury) translates to CAUTION
The equipment-damage ATTENZIONE (torque limit, no injury risk) translates to NOTICE, not CAUTION
The informational NOTA (maintenance log) translates to NOTICE
Severity is never weakened and protective measures stay in imperative mood ('disconnect', 'apply the lock')
The four-level hierarchy DANGER > WARNING > CAUTION > NOTICE is respected throughout
The cross-reference to chapter 5 in the emergency-stop section points to a chapter that exists in the output (the rearm procedure)

evals.name: Filename and revision rules
evals.description: Multi-step session: English translation exists, then French requested, then English redone. Tests filename uniqueness and the revision suffix.
evals.prompt: Step 1: Traduci in inglese in Word. Step 2 (after the English file exists): ora traducilo anche in francese. Step 3 (after the French file exists): rifai la traduzione inglese, ho corretto il capitolo 4.
assertions: French output is sample-manual-it_fr.docx, distinct from the English sample-manual-it_en.docx
French signal words map by severity: PERICOLO to DANGER, AVVERTENZA to AVERTISSEMENT, the crushing-risk ATTENZIONE to ATTENTION, and the property-damage ATTENZIONE and NOTA to AVIS
The French output uses a space as thousands separator: 1.500 pallet/ora becomes 1 500 (digits unchanged)
The second English translation appends _v2 (sample-manual-it_en_v2.docx) and does not overwrite the existing file
No filename in the session contains a date

evals.name: No document provided
evals.description: Translation request with no document, no text, no URL. Tests the entry gate.
evals.prompt: Ciao, puoi tradurre un manuale per me?
assertions: The FIRST message asks for the document (upload, paste, or URL), in Italian
No configuration question and no translation happen before a document arrives

evals.name: Ambiguous term handled without interrupting the run
evals.description: Italian maintenance card containing 'pignone', ambiguous between sprocket and pinion because the transmission type is never stated. Tests the non-blocking ambiguity path: proceed with the most likely meaning, disclose in the completion message, never interrupt the run.
evals.prompt: Traduci in inglese in Word.
assertions: No question of any kind between the start and the completed translation (language and format are both stated)
'pignone' is translated with one consistent most-likely meaning in both sections (sprocket or pinion)
The completion message lists 'pignone' among ambiguous terms, with the meaning chosen
The ambiguity does NOT take the Critical Errors path (it is not safety-critical)
25 ± 0,5 Nm becomes 25 ± 0.5 Nm for English, digits otherwise unchanged
NOTA translates to NOTICE; filename is sample-ambiguous-it_en.docx

evals.name: Scanned image-only PDF - no extractable text
evals.description: User attaches a scanned, image-only PDF. Tests the Phase 1 say-so-and-ask branch: no text extracted, nothing translated or fabricated, user asked for a readable version.
evals.prompt: Ti allego la scansione del manuale della MP-200 (PDF scansionato, solo immagini). Traducilo in inglese in Word.
assertions: The skill states that the PDF is scanned (image-only) and no text can be extracted from it
The skill asks the user for a text version or a different file, and waits
No configuration question is asked and no translation is produced before a readable document arrives
No content is fabricated or guessed from the page images

evals.name: Non-Italian source - German manual to English
evals.description: German source document translated to English as Word. Tests that the workflow runs unchanged for a non-Italian source, the Italian references are not applied, and signal words map by severity level.
evals.prompt: Please translate this German manual to English as a Word document.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (language and format both stated)
GEFAHR, WARNUNG, VORSICHT and HINWEIS translate to DANGER, WARNING, CAUTION and NOTICE, mapped by severity level with the four-level hierarchy preserved
No Italian appears in the output and no Italian reference mapping is applied (the source is German)
Decimal comma converts to period for English: 5,0 bis 25 m/min becomes 5.0 to 25 m/min
EN 60204-1, 6 bar, 120 °C and 85 kg are kept exactly (no unit or value conversion)
Filename is sample-manual-de_en.docx

evals.name: Non-standard signal word placed by severity
evals.description: Italian service card where AVVISO is used at two different severities: electric shock (personal injury) and overtorque damage. Tests that a signal word outside the standard set is placed by hazard severity, never demoted to NOTICE by its word form.
evals.prompt: Traduci in inglese in Word.
assertions: No question of any kind between the start and the completed translation (language and format are both stated)
The electric-shock AVVISO translates to WARNING, not NOTICE - placed by the severity of the hazard
The overtorque AVVISO translates to NOTICE (property damage, no injury risk)
The electric-shock warning keeps its imperative instructions; 230 V and 40 Nm stay unchanged
Filename is sample-avviso-it_en.docx

evals.name: Reverse direction - English manual to Italian
evals.description: English source document translated to Italian as Word. Tests the reverse path: the Italian terminology reference is not applied for a non-Italian source, signal words map by severity into Italian, and the number format converts to the Italian convention.
evals.prompt: Traduci questa scheda in italiano, in Word.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (language and format both stated)
DANGER, WARNING, CAUTION and NOTICE become PERICOLO, AVVERTENZA, ATTENZIONE and NOTA, mapped by severity level
The Italian terminology reference is not applied to build the terminology database (the source is English)
Decimal point converts to comma for Italian: 25 ± 0.5 Nm becomes 25 ± 0,5 Nm; thousands separator converts to period: 6,000 becomes 6.000 (digits unchanged)
EN 60204-1, 16 A, 400 V stay exactly as written; 12 March becomes 12 marzo
Filename is sample-manual-en_it.docx

evals.name: Multi-target request - two languages in one run
evals.description: User requests English and German in one message. Tests the multi-target rule: one file per language in a single run, no repeated configuration.
evals.prompt: Traduci in inglese e tedesco in Word.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (languages and format both stated)
Two files are produced in the one run: sample-manual-it_en.docx and sample-manual-it_de.docx
The English translation uses the English standard signal words (DANGER, WARNING, CAUTION, NOTICE); the German one uses the German set (GEFAHR, WARNUNG, VORSICHT, HINWEIS)

evals.name: Portuguese target - signal words and number format
evals.description: Italian manual translated to Portuguese as Word. Tests the fourth named target option: ISO 3864-2 Portuguese signal words mapped by severity (including the ATENÇÃO-is-graded contrast with Spanish), the Portuguese number convention, and the _pt filename.
evals.prompt: Traduci in portoghese in Word.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (language and format both stated)

Signal words map by severity: PERICOLO to PERIGO, AVVERTENZA to AVISO, the crushing-risk ATTENZIONE to ATENÇÃO (the graded CAUTION word, unlike Spanish ATENCIÓN), and the property-damage ATTENZIONE and NOTA to NOTA
The four-level hierarchy PERIGO > AVISO > ATENÇÃO > NOTA is respected throughout
Decimal separator stays the comma, per Portuguese convention (50 ± 0,05 mm stays 50 ± 0,05 mm, unit names translated)
EN 60204-1 and ISO 13849-1 are kept exactly as written; 6 bar, 350 kg stay unchanged
Filename is sample-manual-it_pt.docx

evals.name: Glossary file intake - user terms override defaults
evals.description: Italian manual plus a company glossary CSV attached alongside. Tests the Phase 4 glossary rule: the glossary merges into the terminology database before translating, user-supplied terms override the industry-standard defaults, and consistency holds.
evals.prompt: Ti allego il manuale della MP-200 e il nostro glossario aziendale. Traducilo in inglese in Word.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (language and format both stated)
The glossary overrides the default mapping: 'quadro elettrico' translates to 'electrical cabinet', not the industry-default 'control panel', at every occurrence
'zona di movimentazione dei pallet' translates to the glossary term 'pallet transfer area', used consistently
All other terms follow the industry-standard mappings; PERICOLO still translates to DANGER (a glossary never touches signal words)
Filename is sample-manual-it_en.docx (the glossary file does not affect the naming rule)
The completion message reports the merged terminology count

evals.name: RTL target - Hebrew PDF
evals.description: Italian manual translated to Hebrew as PDF. Tests the right-to-left guard: weasyprint stays the PDF builder for an RTL target and the fpdf2 fallback is off, signal words map by severity, and degradation is honest rather than silent.
evals.prompt: Traduci questo manuale in ebraico, come PDF.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (language and format both stated)
Filename is sample-manual-it_he.pdf (ISO 639-1 lowercase he)

When building locally, the PDF is produced with weasyprint; the fpdf2 fallback is never used for a right-to-left target - if weasyprint is unavailable, the skill asks the user (install it, or take Markdown) instead of degrading silently
Signal words map by severity level into Hebrew's standard signal words; the four-level hierarchy is preserved
EN 60204-1, ISO 13849-1, 6 bar and 350 kg are kept exactly; the decimal comma converts to the period per Hebrew convention (50 ± 0,05 mm becomes 50 ± 0.05 mm), digits otherwise unchanged
Page size is A4 (the Markdown source defines no page geometry)

evals.name: Glossary given in the configuration answer
evals.description: Multi-turn: Italian manual attached, nothing stated in the first message; the user's answer to the configuration question carries one term preference. Tests the Phase 4 rule that a glossary from the answers merges into the terminology database and overrides the industry defaults.
evals.prompt: Step 1: Ti allego il manuale della MP-200. Step 2 (as the reply to the configuration question): Inglese, Word, e usa 'quadro elettrico' per 'electrical cabinet'.
assertions: Exactly ONE message asks for target language, output format, and optional special requirements together, before any translation
A message reporting document size and processing strategy appears before the question, in the language of the user's request
The term from the answer overrides the default: 'quadro elettrico' translates to 'electrical cabinet', not the industry-default 'control panel', at every occurrence
PERICOLO still translates to DANGER (a glossary never touches signal words)
After the answer, no further question is asked and the file is produced
Filename is sample-manual-it_en.docx and the completion message reports the merged terminology count

evals.name: RTL Word output - Hebrew target
evals.description: Italian manual translated to Hebrew as Word. Tests the Word side of the right-to-left rule: paragraph direction set in the output file, signal words mapped by severity, and the number convention. Complements case 19, which tests the PDF side.
evals.prompt: Traduci questo manuale in ebraico, in Word.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (language and format both stated)
Filename is sample-manual-it_he.docx (ISO 639-1 lowercase he)
Hebrew paragraphs in the Word file carry right-to-left direction
Signal words map by severity level into Hebrew's standard signal words; the four-level hierarchy is preserved
EN 60204-1, ISO 13849-1, 6 bar and 350 kg are kept exactly; the decimal comma converts to the period per Hebrew convention (50 ± 0,05 mm becomes 50 ± 0.05 mm), digits otherwise unchanged
Signed numeric runs such as 50 ± 0.05 mm read left-to-right inside the RTL paragraphs, with the sign attached to its value (not mirrored or detached)
Page size is A4 (the Markdown source defines no page geometry)

evals.name: Multi-source request - two documents in one run
evals.description: Two source documents attached in one message, target language and format stated for both. Tests the Phase 1 multi-source rule: each document runs through the workflow and gets its own deliverable, with one configuration pass and per-document language handling.
evals.prompt: Ti allego il manuale della MP-200 e quello dell'ETL-40. Traducili entrambi in inglese in Word.
assertions: No configuration question is asked (language and format both stated)
Two files are produced in the one run: sample-manual-it_en.docx and sample-manual-de_en.docx
Signal words map by severity in each output: PERICOLO to DANGER in the MP-200 output, GEFAHR to DANGER in the ETL-40 output
The Italian references apply only to the Italian source; no Italian reference mapping is applied to the German source

eval_notes: All sample material is fictional: evals/sample-manual-it.md is an invented Italian operating and maintenance manual for a pallet mover (model MP-200) containing all four signal-word levels including the two ATTENZIONE trap cases; evals/sample-troubleshooting-it.md is an invented Italian specification/troubleshooting sheet for an RF-10 filling line; evals/sample-ambiguous-it.md is an invented maintenance card built around 'pignone', ambiguous between sprocket and pinion; evals/sample-manual-de.md is an invented German operating manual for an ETL-40 labeling machine (cases 13 and 22) exercising the non-Italian source path; evals/sample-avviso-it.md is an invented service card using the non-standard signal word AVVISO at two severities (case 14); evals/sample-manual-en.md is an invented English service card for a CV-15 conveyor (case 15) exercising the reverse English-to-Italian path; evals/sample-glossary.csv is an invented two-term company glossary for the MP-200 manual (case 18). Case 12 expects the runner to attach any image-only scanned PDF; the page content is irrelevant because no text may be extracted. Cases cover: defaults and the combined question (1), skip rule with German target and the A4 fallback (2), partial preferences and decimal conversion (3), Markdown honesty (4), the unsupported-format gate (5), pasted text (6), URL entry (7), the four-level signal-word mapping (8), filename and revision rules (9), missing document (10), non-blocking ambiguity disclosure (11), scanned-PDF refusal (12), non-Italian source with severity-based mapping (13), non-standard signal words placed by severity (14), the reverse English-to-Italian direction (15), multi-target single-run delivery (16), the Portuguese target with ISO 3864-2 signal words (17), glossary-file intake with user terms overriding the defaults (18), and the right-to-left Hebrew target with the weasyprint-only PDF guard (19), a glossary supplied in the configuration answer with terms overriding the defaults (20), and the Hebrew Word target with right-to-left paragraph direction (21), and the two-document multi-source request with one configuration pass and one deliverable per document (22). Every case that produces a file expects the [original_filename]_[language_code].[ext] convention from SKILL.md.
